notes: `EXEC exec;` replaces the s32[16] buffer. cdrom_LoadExec(&exec) fills it, and `exec.s_addr = a2; exec.s_size = 0;` sets the stack fields that PsyQ Exec reads. The call is Exec(&exec, a0, a1), against a truthful `Exec(struct EXEC *, s32, s32 *)` prototype with no cast. The parameters assert nothing false: a0 is argc (the caller passes 6). a1 is the argv word array, which func_80037540 fills with mixed pointers and ints, so `s32 *` is accurate. a2 is the stack top (func_800392B8()+0x7FC) stored to s_addr. sandbox --disable all scores 0 (54/54).
